Exercise 5.2 · Week 5

Stamp Garden

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: break a picture into named parts with two My Blocks (grass and flower (size)) and stamp a garden that is different every time. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension. Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project and add the Pen extension. Delete the cat.
  2. Hover over Choose a Sprite and click the Paint brush. Draw a flower in the middle of the canvas (a circle for the center and circles for petals). Name the sprite Flower.
  3. Make a My Block flower with an input size.
  4. Make a My Block grass with no input.
  5. Build the three scripts below. For the grass color, click the color circle in set pen color to and set Color 45, Saturation 100, Brightness 62 (bluish green from the color-safe paint box).
  6. Click the green flag a few times: a new garden grows each time.
  7. Save as stamp-garden.

The scripts in words

define flower (size)

  • set size to (size) %
  • change color effect by 25
  • stamp

define grass

  • set pen color to (bluish green)
  • set pen size to 60
  • go to x: -240 y: -150
  • pen down
  • go to x: 240 y: -150
  • pen up

when green flag clicked

  • erase all
  • clear graphic effects
  • show
  • grass
  • repeat 12:
    • go to x: (pick random -220 to 220) y: (pick random -140 to 120)
    • flower (pick random 30 to 100)
  • hide

Expected behavior

Each click on the green flag clears the stage, draws a thick strip of grass along the bottom, and stamps 12 flowers in surprise places. The flowers have different sizes and different colors. At the end the Flower sprite hides, so only the stamped garden is left. Every garden is different.

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

Your green-flag script should read like a plan: grass first, then flowers. The details live inside the two pink blocks in the My Blocks category, grass and flower.

Hint 2: Try this

Flowers are copies of your painted sprite. Use the stamp block from the Pen category. To make every flower different, use pick random blocks (Operators category) for the position and the size. change color effect (Looks category) changes the color.

Hint 3: Almost there

In the flag script, use repeat ____. Inside it, use go to x: (pick random ____ to ____) y: (pick random ____ to ____), then flower (pick random ____ to ____). In define flower, drag the size oval into set size to ( ) %.
